caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a carved wooden bird decoy, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bird has a long, straight beak and a smoothly contoured body, with its head facing to the left. The coloring consists primarily of muted brown tones for the head, back, and wings, with lighter and darker shades used to suggest feathers and form. Fine lines and subtle gradations of color on the body and tail indicate detail in the carving and texture. The wings and tail are stylized, with visible carved grooves. There are no additional objects or details in the background, and the drawing focuses solely on this bird-shaped object.
title: Snipe
